items.title: Spain will send troops to Ceuta to help with border security
items.description: Authorities in the Spanish city of Ceuta asked Madrid to declare a national emergency and send military assistance. Crowds of people breached the border of the territory next to Morocco as police lost control.

items.title: How two wars and El Nino could fuel world hunger
items.description: The wars in Ukraine and the Middle East haven't yet crippled global food supplies. Add a powerful weather pattern like El Nino, however, and the risks multiply.

items.title: Mali: HRW accuses Russian paramilitaries of killing 8 civilians
items.description: Russian paramilitaries from Africa Corps, which is supporting Mali in its fight against insurgents, killed eight civilians, including three children, in June airstrikes, Human Rights Watch (HRW) said in a report Friday.
